scenes.title: 周末聊什么

scenes.brief: 周一早上，同事 Mia 问你周末过得怎么样。

how about you|what about you|and you\b

scenes.title: 电梯里聊天气
scenes.persona: Lily, a cheerful colleague from another team on the same floor, riding the elevator with the learner in the morning
scenes.opening: Morning! Wow, did you see how dark the sky is outside?
scenes.opening_zh: 早！哇，你看到外面天多暗了吗？
scenes.brief: 早上在电梯里遇到隔壁组的同事，简单聊几句天气。

tasks.zh: 回应对方并说说今天的天气
tasks.check: the learner says something about today's weather

tasks.zh: 说说天气对你的影响或感受
tasks.check: the learner says how the weather affects them or how they feel about it
the learner asks Lily a question (e.g. about her plans, whether she brought an umbrella)
the learner actually says goodbye or wraps up the chat (e.g. 'Nice meeting you', 'See you around', 'I have to go')

hints.en: It looks like it's going to rain.

review.title: 周复习：和老朋友喝咖啡
review.persona: Jess, an old friend from university who moved to Shenzhen from Australia a few years ago. You meet the learner at a café for a relaxed catch-up. You are warm, chatty and curious
review.opening: Hey, there you are! I was starting to think you forgot about me.
review.opening_zh: 嘿，你终于来了！我还以为你把我忘了呢。
review.brief: 和老朋友 Jess 约在咖啡馆叙旧。你迟到了一会儿，先道个歉，再聊周末、天气、最近看的剧、最近累不累，最后约下次见面。
